paragraphs: So, in the second year that Darius was king, around October, God's message hit up the prophet Zechariah (son of Berechiah, who was the son of Iddo). God was like, "I was seriously not happy with your ancestors. So, tell the people this message from the God of Angel Armies: 'Come back to me, and I'll come back to you. Don't be like your parents. The prophets back in the day told them, 'A message from the God of Angel Armies: Drop your messed-up life. Stop the evil stuff you're doing.' But they straight up ignored everything I said, being stubborn and refusing to listen.'

"And where are your ancestors now? Yep, dead and gone. And the prophets who called them out? Also dead and gone. But the message my servants the prophets spoke? That's not dead. That message did a number on your ancestors, didn't it? It woke them up and they came back, saying, 'He did what he said he would do, for real. We didn't get away with anything.'"
On the 24th day of the 11th month, in the second year Darius was king, the message of God was given to the prophet Zechariah, son of Berechiah, son of Iddo:
One night I was looking out and saw a guy on a red horse. He was chilling in the shadows in a grove of birch trees. Behind him were more horses—a red one, a chestnut one, and a white one.
I was like, "Sir, what are these horses doing here? What's the deal with this?"
The Angel-Messenger said, "Let me show you."
Then the rider in the birch grove spoke up, "These are the riders God sent to check things out on earth."
They reported what they found to the Angel of God in the birch grove: "We've checked out the whole earth and everything's calm. It's all under control."
The Angel of God reported back, "O God of the Angel Armies, how long are you going to be mad at Jerusalem and the cities of Judah? When are you going to chill? Hasn't seventy years been long enough?"

God then said some good, comforting words to the Angel-Messenger, who then told me: "Tell them this. Tell them that the God of Angel Armies has spoken. This is God's message: 'I care a ton about Jerusalem and Zion. I'm super protective of them. But I'm really mad at the godless nations that act like they own the world. I was only a little mad before, but now they've gone way too far. I'm about to do something.'

"'I've come back to Jerusalem, but with compassion this time.' This is God speaking. 'I'll make sure my Temple gets rebuilt.' A decree from the God of Angel Armies! 'The rebuilding is already being planned out.' Say it again—a decree from the God of Angel Armies: 'My cities will be successful again, God will comfort Zion again, and Jerusalem will be my favorite again.'"
I looked up and was surprised by another vision: four horns!
I asked the Messenger-Angel, "And what's the meaning of this?"
He said, "These are the powers that have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem all over the place."
Then God showed me a vision with four blacksmiths.
I asked, "And what are these guys for?"

He said, "Since the 'horns' scattered Judah so bad that no one had any hope left, these blacksmiths have shown up to fight the horns. They'll dehorn the godless nations who used their horns to scatter Judah to the four winds."

title: God's Moving In?! Jerusalem's Epic Glow-Up

splits.note: MSG 1-5 one para; Teenz splits v1-2a / v2b / v3-5

paragraphs: I looked up and, no cap, there was a dude holding a tape measure. I was like, “Yo, what are you up to?”
He said, “I’m about to go measure Jerusalem, see how wide and long it is.”

Then, right at that moment, the angel who was with me was heading out and another angel came to meet him, saying, “Run! Go tell that surveyor guy, ‘Jerusalem is gonna be so packed with people and animals that it won’t even have walls. And I’ll be right there with her’—this is God’s decree—‘like a wall of fire all around unwalled Jerusalem, and I'll be a radiant presence right in the middle of it.’”

“Up on your feet! Get out of there—like, now!” God says so. “Come back from your exile in that far-off land. I scattered you to the four winds.” God’s decree. “Zion, you gotta escape from Babylon and come home—now!”

God-of-the-Angel-Armies, the One of Glory who sent me on my mission, had this to say about the godless nations that totally stripped you and left you homeless: “Anyone who hits you, hits me—it’s like they’re poking me in the eye. Yeah, and when the time is right, I’ll give the signal and they’ll get stripped and thrown out by their own servants.” Then you’ll know for real that God-of-the-Angel-Armies sent me on this mission.
“Shout and celebrate, Daughter of Zion! I’m on my way. I’m moving into your neighborhood!” That’s God’s decree.

At that time, a bunch of other nations will link up with God. (“They will become my family! I’ll live in their homes!”) And then you’ll know for sure that God-of-the-Angel-Armies sent me on this mission. God will reclaim his inheritance in Judah in the Holy Land. He’ll again make it clear that Jerusalem is his top choice.
Quiet, everyone! Shh! Be silent before God. Something is going down in his holy house. He’s making his move!

title: Joshua's Courtroom Drama: From Dirty Rags to Divine Robes
paragraphs: Alright, so next the Messenger-Angel showed me this vision of the high priest, Joshua. He was just standing there in front of God's Angel, and then boom, the Accuser—basically, Satan—rolls up to start pointing fingers. But God was like, 'Yo, Accuser, I shut you down! I'm shutting you down because I've chosen Jerusalem. Surprise! It looks like everything's a dumpster fire, but I'm reaching in and pulling Jerusalem right out of the flames.'

So there's Joshua, standing in front of the angel, and his clothes are just nasty, like he's been mud-wrestling. The angel turns to his crew and says, 'Get these gross clothes off him.' Then he looks at Joshua and says, 'See? I've totally wiped away your sin and I'm hooking you up with a fresh new fit.'

Then I couldn't help myself, I chimed in like, 'Hey, what about a clean new turban for his head too?' And they were like, 'Good call!' So they put a fresh turban on him and finished getting him all dressed up, with God's Angel watching the whole time.

Then God's Angel got serious and gave Joshua the official charge. He was like, 'This is a message from the God-of-the-Angel-Armies: If you stick to my ways and stay loyal in serving me, you'll be the one in charge of my house and my courts. Plus, all these angels standing here will have your back.'

'Listen up, High Priest Joshua—this is for you and your crew sitting here with you, 'cause you guys are a sign of what's coming. Here's the deal: I'm about to introduce my servant, Branch. And get this: I'm putting this special stone in front of Joshua, a single stone with seven eyes on it.' This is a decree from the God-of-the-Angel-Armies, who says, 'I'm gonna engrave a message on it myself: I'm going to wipe out all the sin from this land, like, all at once, in a single day.'
'When that day comes, everyone's gonna be chill with each other, inviting their neighbors over for a hangout, just visiting and vibing on each other's porches.'

title: Don't Sleep on Small Beginnings

paragraphs: The angel who was talking to me came back and woke me up, like when you're in a super deep sleep.
He asked, “Yo, what do you see?”
I was like, “I see this solid gold lampstand with a bowl on top. It's got seven lamps, and each lamp has seven spouts. And there are two olive trees, one on each side.”
So I asked the angel, “Sir, what's the deal with all this?”
The angel was like, “You seriously don't get it?”
“Nah, for real, I don't,” I said.

Then he explained, “This is God's message for Zerubbabel: It's not about your own strength or power. It's all about my Spirit, says the LORD of Heaven's Armies. So that huge mountain in your way? It's gonna look like a tiny little hill next to Zerubbabel. He's gonna lay the final stone of the temple, and everyone's gonna be cheering, ‘Let's go! Let's go! Get it done!’”

Then God's word came to me again: “Zerubbabel laid the foundation of this temple, and he's gonna be the one to finish it. That's how you'll know for sure that the LORD of Heaven's Armies sent me to you. Who dares to look down on these small beginnings? They'll be singing a different tune when they see Zerubbabel putting that final stone in place!”
Back to the vision, the angel said, “Those seven lamps? They're the eyes of the LORD, searching every nook and cranny of the world.”
I asked, “But what about the two olive trees on each side of the lampstand? What do they mean? And what about the two olive branches that are pouring oil into the lamps?”
He was like, “You still haven't figured it out?”
I said, “Nope, no clue, sir.”
He said, “These are the two who are anointed to serve the Lord of all the earth, supplying his light to the whole world.”

I asked the angel, "Yo, where are they taking that basket?"
He said, "They're taking it east to Shinar. They're going to build a special place for it, and once it's ready, the basket will be stored there for good."

paragraphs: On the fourth day of the ninth month, during the fourth year King Darius was in charge, God hit up Zechariah with another message.

Basically, the town of Bethel sent a crew with Sarezer and Regem-Melech to go pray and get some advice from the priests at the Temple of God-of-the-Angel-Armies, and the prophets too. They asked, “So, like, should we still do our big sad fast in August to mark the 70th anniversary of Jerusalem getting wrecked, like we’ve been doing for years?”

God-of-the-Angel-Armies gave me this message for all the people and the priests: “Yo, when you were fasting all dramatically in the fifth and seventh months for the last seventy years, were you *really* doing that for me? And when you had big parties and feasts, was that for me either? Lowkey, no. You're all about the religious rules, but I'm all about the people.

“There’s nothing new to say here. Don’t you remember the message from the OG prophets back when Jerusalem was popping and the whole area—the Negev and Shephelah—was full of people? God gave Zechariah this message, and it hasn't changed. God-of-the-Angel-Armies said it then and is saying it now:
“‘Treat each other right. Love your neighbors. Be compassionate. Don’t rip off widows, orphans, immigrants, or the poor. And stop plotting against each other—that’s just evil.’

“But did your ancestors listen? Nah, they were stubborn. They plugged their ears. They totally hardened their hearts against God’s truth and the sermons the earlier prophets gave, which were straight from the Spirit by order of God-of-the-Angel-Armies. And God got legit angry, because he laid it all out for them, and they wouldn't listen to a single word.

“So, God-of-the-Angel-Armies was like, ‘Fine, if you won't listen to me, I'm not listening to you.’ He scattered them to the four winds, making them strangers in foreign lands. Their awesome ‘promised land’ turned into a total wasteland—just weeds and trash. Zero signs of life. They turned a dream into a dump.”

paragraphs: Yo, so God of the Angel Armies dropped some more messages, and here's the deal:
This is a message from the God of the Angel Armies:
"I'm super passionate about Zion, like, I actually care. I'm kinda mad about what's happened to Zion, so I'm getting involved."
God's message continued:
"I'm back in Zion, for real. I've moved back to Jerusalem. Jerusalem's gonna get some new nicknames: 'Truth City,' 'Mountain of the God of the Angel Armies,' and 'Mount Holiness.' How cool is that?"
A message from the God of the Angel Armies:

"Old guys and ladies will be chilling in Jerusalem again, sitting on benches in the streets, telling stories, and walking around safely with their canes. It's gonna be a great place to grow old. And kids, boys and girls, will be all over the parks, laughing and playing. It's gonna be a great place to grow up."
A message from the God of the Angel Armies:
"So, you think the problems of coming back and rebuilding with just a few people are too much? Seriously? Is anything too much for me? Not a chance."
A message from the God of the Angel Armies:

"I'm gonna gather my people from all over, from the east and the west. I'll bring them back and they'll live in Jerusalem. They'll be my people, and I'll be their God. I'm gonna stick with them and always do right by them."
A message from the God of the Angel Armies:

"Alright, get it together. Listen up, you who are hearing what I'm saying through the prophets. The Temple of the God of the Angel Armies is back. The Temple is being rebuilt. We've been through some tough times, for sure. You were working for basically nothing, and the streets were sketchy. You always had to watch your back. I had turned the world into a war zone.
"But things are different now. I'm on the side of my crew of survivors.
"You'll be able to plant and harvest again. The vines will have grapes, the gardens will be poppin', and everything will be green and lush.

"My crew of survivors will have everything they need and then some. You guys in Judah and Israel have had a bad rap, like you're the bad-news crew. But I'm coming to save you. From now on, you're the good-news crew. So don't be scared. Just hold on to what I'm doing."
A message from the God of the Angel Armies:

"Just like I decided to punish your ancestors when they made me mad, and I didn't hold back, now I've decided to bless Jerusalem and Judah. Don't be afraid. So here's what I want you to do: Tell the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth. Be good to each other, in your personal lives and in court. Don't be scheming to get ahead by taking advantage of people. Don't say or do things that aren't true. I hate all that stuff. Just keep your lives simple and honest. That's a decree from God."
Then I got another message from the God of the Angel Armies:
"Those sad days you had in the fourth, fifth, seventh, and tenth months? They're gonna be party days for Judah. Feasts, celebrations, holidays. So embrace truth and love peace!"
A message from the God of the Angel Armies:

"People and their leaders are gonna come from all over to see what's up. The leaders will be like, 'Yo, shouldn't we get in on this? Get some of God's blessings? Pray to the God of the Angel Armies? What are we waiting for? Let's go!'
"Tons of people, even powerful nations, will come to Jerusalem to see what they can get from the God of the Angel Armies, trying to get a blessing from God."
A message from the God of the Angel Armies:
"When that time comes, ten guys who speak different languages will grab a Jewish person's sleeve, hold on tight, and say, 'Let us go with you. We heard God is with you.'"

paragraphs: War Bulletin:

God's message is calling out the country of Hadrach. It's gonna land hard on Damascus. The whole world is watching God, not just Israel. That includes Hamath on the border, and Tyre and Sidon, who think they're so smart. Tyre built a crazy kingdom for itself, stacking up silver like firewood and piling up gold like haystacks. But for real, God's gonna make them go bankrupt. He's gonna toss all that wealth into the ocean and burn what's left in a huge fire. Ashkelon will see it and freak out, Gaza will be wringing its hands, and Ekron will hit a dead end. Gaza's king will die. Ashkelon will be a ghost town, and some random villain will take over Ashdod.

“I’m gonna humble proud Philistia. I’ll make them spit out their gross, bloody sacrifices and give up their nasty habits.” Whatever's left will belong to God—a small group of survivors, a family brought together in Judah. But enemies like Ekron will end up like the Jebusites—basically, erased from history. “I'm gonna set up camp in my own country and protect it from anyone who tries to invade. No one is ever gonna mess with my people again. I'm keeping a close watch on them.

“Shout and get hyped, Zion! Let's hear you, Jerusalem! Your king is coming! He's a good king who makes everything right, a humble king riding on a donkey, just a young colt. I'm so over war—no more chariots in Ephraim, no more war horses in Jerusalem, no more swords and spears, bows and arrows. He's gonna bring peace to all the nations, a peaceful rule over the whole world, from the four winds to the seven seas.

“And as for you, because of the blood covenant I made with you, I'm gonna free your prisoners from their hopeless situations. Come home, you prisoners who now have hope! Today, I'm telling you, you're getting a double bonus—everything you lost is coming back to you, times two! Judah is my new weapon, the bow I'm gonna pull. Ephraim is the arrow I'm loading up. I'm gonna get your sons, Zion, ready to fight against the sons of Greece. From now on, my people are my swords.”

Then God will show up, and his arrows will flash like lightning! The Lord GOD will sound the trumpet and march out in a whirlwind. The GOD-of-the-Angel-Armies will protect them. It's gonna be an all-out war, the war to end all wars, no holding back. Their God will save them that day. He'll rescue them. They'll be like gentle sheep, or like shiny jewels in a crown, sparkling in the sun. They're gonna shine so bright! The young men will be strong and the young women will be beautiful!

title: God's Epic Comeback Plan

splits.note: MSG shares v3 across 2-3 and 3-5 paras

paragraphs: Ayo, when you need that spring rain, you gotta ask God for it. He's the one who makes the thunderstorms happen and gets the crops growing.

Those fake gods you see in stores? Total nonsense. And the religious gurus? They're just talking trash. Their advice is basically smoke. So the people are all lost, like sheep without a shepherd to look after them. God is seriously ticked off at these so-called leaders. He thinks they're a joke and is gonna treat them like it.

But God, the leader of the angel armies, is gonna step in and take care of his squad, the people of Judah. He's gonna hype them up and make them proud to be on his team. God's gonna use them in his big rebuilding project, like they're the foundation and the main pillars. They'll be the tools and the supervisors for the whole thing. They'll be a crew to be proud of, all working together, super confident, walking through any mess. They'll be brave and full of energy because God is with them, not scared of any bullies.

God's like, "I'm gonna make the people of Judah strong; I'm gonna rescue the people of Joseph. I see what they've been through, and I'm gonna give them a total reset. It's a fresh start, like none of the bad stuff ever happened. Why? 'Cause I'm their God, and I'll do whatever it takes for them. The people of Ephraim will be famous, their lives just filled with good vibes. Their kids will get in on it too—man, they'll see how blessed they are by God! I'll just give a signal, and they'll all come running back. I've freed them, and they're gonna thrive, for real. Even though I scattered them all over the world, they'll remember me way out there. They'll pass down the stories to their kids, and they will come back home. I'll bring them back from Egypt in the west and gather them from Assyria in the east. I'll bring them back to the good land of Gilead and Lebanon. The whole place will be filled with people coming home. They'll get through any tough times, pushing past any obstacle. Huge rivers will seem like nothing. Flashy Assyria will get exposed, and bully Egypt will be shown for the fraud it is. But my people—yo, I'll make them super strong, God-level strong! And they'll live life my way." That's a promise from God!

title: God Fires a Shepherd & Breaks Everything

splits.note: MSG shares v4 across 1-4 and 4-5 paras

paragraphs: Alright, Lebanon, you think you're so great? Open up your gates, 'cause a fire is coming for your famous trees. All you big-shot pine trees, get ready to cry. And you cedars? You're basically just firewood now. Hey, Bashan oaks, you can weep too. Your super thick forest? It's about to be a field of stumps. You hear that? That's the sound of shepherds freaking out 'cause they just lost everything. And the lions? They're roaring mad 'cause their jungle home in the Jordan is totally wrecked. Make way for the people coming back from exile!

God told me, 'Go be a shepherd to these sheep that are basically walking dead.' The people who buy them are just gonna kill them for a quick buck, and no one's gonna do anything about it. The sellers are all like, 'Sweet! I'm rich! God must love me!' And the shepherds they have now? They literally could not care less about them.

God's decree was basically: 'I'm washing my hands of the people of this land. From now on they’re all on their own. It’s a total free-for-all, survival of the fittest, every person for themselves. Don't even think about asking me for help.'

So I took over from the trashy, money-hungry owners and started shepherding the sheep that were marked for slaughter. I got myself two shepherd staffs. I named one 'Grace' and the other 'Unity.' Then I got to work. In less than a month, I got rid of the three corrupt shepherds. I was so over their drama—and they couldn't stand me either.

But then I got tired of the sheep too and was like, 'I'm out. No more shepherding from me. If you die, you die. If you get attacked, you get attacked. Whoever's left can just eat each other for all I care.'
Then I took my staff named 'Grace' and snapped it in half. Just like that, the awesome promise I had with all the people was broken. The greedy owners saw me do it and knew it was a message from God.
Then I told them, 'Pay me what you think I'm worth.' So they paid me a ridiculously insulting amount: thirty silver coins. It was a joke.
God told me, 'Throw it in the charity box.' That's how little they thought of me and all my work! So I took the thirty silver coins and chucked them into the charity box at God's Temple.
Then I broke my other staff, 'Unity,' and snapped it in half, breaking the family bond between Judah and Israel.

Then God said, 'Now, go act like a totally clueless shepherd. Because I'm about to put a shepherd just like that in charge of this land—a shepherd who doesn't care about the suffering, ignores the lost, abandons the injured, and looks down on good people. He'll only be in it for himself, using and abusing everyone.

'You're so screwed, you useless shepherd, just walking away and leaving the sheep! A curse on your arm and a curse on your right eye! Your arm will be totally useless, and your right eye will go completely blind.'

title: Jerusalem's Epic Comeback Story

splits.note: MSG 1-2; Teenz splits 'War Bulletin' intro from oracle

paragraphs: War Bulletin:

A message from God about Israel, a decree from the very God who created the universe, put the earth in its place, and gave us life: 'Yo, check this out: I'm about to make Jerusalem like a super strong drink that will make all the people attacking Judah and Jerusalem totally wasted and confused.'

'On that big day, I'm gonna make Jerusalem like a massive boulder that nobody can move. Anyone who tries to lift it will get seriously hurt. All the other nations will team up to try and get rid of it, but it's not gonna happen.'

'On that day,' God says, 'I'll make all the enemy horses freak out and their riders too. But I'll be watching over Judah, keeping them safe, while I make the enemy's horses go blind. The people of Judah will be like, 'Wow, our leaders are super strong because of God, our God.'

'On that day, I'll make the families of Judah like a lit match in a dry forest, or a torch in a barn full of hay. They'll destroy everyone around them, left and right, while Jerusalem gets filled up with its own people again, making it their home.'

'I, God, will start by helping out the regular families of Judah first, so that the big shots in David's family and the leaders in Jerusalem don't get all the glory and overshadow the ordinary people. On that day, I'll take care of everyone in Jerusalem, so even the weakest person will be as awesome as King David, and David's family will be like angels leading the people.'
'On that day, I'm gonna completely get rid of all the nations that came to fight against Jerusalem.'

'Then, I'll deal with David's family and the people in Jerusalem. I'll give them a spirit of grace and prayer. They'll finally realize that I'm the one they hurt so badly, the one they stabbed with a spear. And they will be so, so sorry. They'll cry and mourn like a parent who lost their first child. The sadness in Jerusalem that day will be huge, as famous as the mourning for Hadad-Rimmon in the fields of Megiddo.'

'Everyone will be crying and grieving, the whole land and everyone in it: David's family by themselves, and their women by themselves; Nathan's family by themselves, and their women by themselves; Levi's family by themselves, and their women by themselves; Shimei's family by themselves, and their women by themselves; and all the other families by themselves, and their women by themselves.'

title: No More Fakes
paragraphs: On that epic day, a fountain's gonna burst open for David's fam and all the Jerusalem crew. It's for a total spiritual shower, washing away all their sin and grime.

God of the Angel Armies says, 'On that day, I'm deleting all the fake, store-bought gods from existence. Their names will be totally erased from memory. People will be like, 'Never heard of 'em.' And I'm kicking out all those prophets who were polluting the world with their toxic talk.' And get this—if someone keeps trying to spread those toxic, polluting words, their own parents will step up and be like, 'Dude, you're done. Your lies about God are putting everyone at risk.' And then, no joke, they'll take him out right then and there while he's prophesying. His own parents!

On that same epic day, all the lying prophets are gonna get totally exposed and humiliated. They'll be wishing they never scammed people with their so-called 'visions.' No more pretending to be prophets. They'll be like, 'A prophet? Who, me? Nah, I'm just a farmer, been working the land my whole life.' And if someone points out, 'So, what's with the black eye?' they'll just make up some lame excuse like, 'Oh, I walked into a door at my friend's place.'

Then God of the Angel Armies gives this command: 'Sword, go after my shepherd, my right-hand man! Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will scatter. I'll even turn my back on the little lambs.' God's decree says that all over the land, two-thirds will be wiped out, but one-third will make it through. And that surviving third? I'm gonna put them through the fire, like refining silver, and test them like gold to see if they're the real deal. Then they'll call my name, and I'll answer them personally. I'll say, 'You are my people.' And they'll say, 'God is my God!'

title: God's Ultimate Battle Royale

splits.note: MSG shares v14 across 12-14 and 14-15 paras

paragraphs: Yo, for real, God's Judgment Day is coming. It's gonna be wild. Loot will be stacked high and passed around. God's bringing all the nations that don't follow Him to attack Jerusalem. Houses will be robbed, women assaulted, half the city will be dragged into exile, and the other half just left behind.

But then, plot twist! God will march out and fight those nations Himself—it's gonna be a huge war! On that day, He'll stand on the Mount of Olives, east of Jerusalem. The Mount of Olives will literally split down the middle, east to west, creating a massive valley. Half the mountain will move north, the other half south. You'll have to run for your lives down that valley, your escape route that goes all the way to Azal. You'll be running for your life, just like people did during that insane earthquake back when Uzziah was king. Then my God will show up with all the holy angels.
That day is gonna be something else. No more cold nights—actually, no more nights at all! The Day is coming—God's got the timing—when it'll be daylight 24/7. Every evening will just be a new morning.
What a day that will be! Fresh rivers will flow out of Jerusalem, one half to the eastern sea, the other half to the western sea, flowing all year round, summer and winter.
God will be king over the whole earth, one God and one God only. That day will be legendary.

And the land around Jerusalem will stretch out wide—from Geba in the north to Rimmon in the south. Jerusalem will be towering in the center, with all its main gates—from the Gate of Benjamin to the First Gate to the Corner Gate, and from the Tower of Hananel to the Royal Winery—the city will be packed with people. Jerusalem will never be completely destroyed again. From then on, it'll be a safe city.

But here's what's gonna happen to everyone who fought against Jerusalem: God will hit them with a gnarly plague. People's skin will rot right off their bones while they're still walking around. Their eyes will rot in their sockets, and their tongues will rot in their mouths. People will literally be dying on their feet! It'll be mass chaos when that happens—total panic. Soldiers will start fighting and killing each other—it's gonna be terrifying. And then Judah will jump into the fight.

The treasures from all the nations will be piled high—gold, silver, and all the latest styles. The plague will also hit the animals—horses, mules, camels, donkeys. Everything alive in the enemy camps will get hit by the plague.

All the survivors from the nations that fought Jerusalem will have to go to Jerusalem every year to worship the King, God-of-the-Angel-Armies, and to celebrate the Feast of Booths. If any of these survivors don't make the yearly trip to Jerusalem to worship the King, God-of-the-Angel-Armies, they won't get any rain. If the Egyptians don't go and worship, no rain for them either. Any nation that doesn't go up to celebrate the Feast of Booths will get hit with the plague. Egypt and any other nation that skips the pilgrimage to celebrate the Feast of Booths will get punished.

On that Day, the Big Day, even the bells on the horses' harnesses will be engraved with 'Holy to God.' The cooking pots in God's Temple will be as sacred as the special cups and plates on the altar. In fact, every single pot and pan in all the kitchens of Jerusalem and Judah will be holy to God-of-the-Angel-Armies. People who come to worship and prepare their meals and sacrifices will use them. On that Big Day, there will be no more buying or selling in the Temple of God-of-the-Angel-Armies.
